The dialogue presents a clinical case of a patient with progressive behavioral and cognitive changes—specifically disinhibition (inappropriate laughing, foul language, impulsive grabbing), executive dysfunction, and worsening memory—beginning several months ago and now impairing self-care. - **Neuroimaging**: MRI demonstrates **frontal and temporal lobe atrophy**, consistent with FTLD spectrum pathology.
